checks.contract: Flush, Stop, Reset, and Rebuild execute their expected ordered stages, resend SPS/PPS/IDR, preserve a valid Surface Lease, and never open output after a failed recovery.
The 60-AU fixture starts with an IDR carrying SPS/PPS, every IDR repeats SPS/PPS, malformed streams are rejected, and access units are contiguous and bounded.
Output buffers use only RenderOutputBuffer or FreeOutputBuffer; OH_AVBuffer_GetAddr is used only for encoded input.
